text: At its meeting held May 22 and 23, 2024, City Council considered item CA16.3 - Appointment of a Public Member to the Toronto Preservation Board, and appointed the following member to the Toronto Preservation Board for a term of office starting May 24, 2024 and ending February 9, 2028: - Peter Pantalone This appointment fills the vacancy left by Robert Allsopp who resigned on April 14, 2024.
The Toronto Preservation board received this item for information.
